Name: Recycling Crafts
Author: SGUERO
Description:
[b][u][size=4]Summary[/size][/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Are you tired of having to dispose of low tier objects when upgrading to higher tier ones?
[*]Do you get frustrated when finding and receiving useless early game items after you've already moved on to better ones?
[*]Do you like when mods give you all the options you need to easily and precisely customize your playing experience, without trivializing the game?
[/list]Well aren't you lucky, because [b]this [/b]is the mod for you!

With [i]"Recycling Crafts"[/i] you'll be able to change the existing crafting recipes for upgraded items, to substitute some ingredients with basic versions of those items: e.g. using Sprinklers to craft Quality Sprinklers. In the base game (ver. 1.6.x) you need 2 Furnaces to craft a Heavy Furnace, and a Worm Bin to craft a Deluxe Worm Bin, but what if you could do the same with many, many other objects? There are also a few brand new recipes that you might decide to add to your game.
Don't be afraid of making the game too easy for yourself though, all revised and new recipes are designed to keep the experience as balanced as possible: e.g. if an object has "Iridium" in its name or requires a late game ingredient you still gotta need some of that good stuff!
Want to change a couple of recipes and not the others? Want to add some, all or none of the new recipes? Want to decide how many Chests you need to craft a Big Chest? With this mod you can do it all... almost!

[size=4][b][u]Requirements & Compatibility[/u][/b][/size]

To run this mod you will need [b]Stardew Valley ver. 1.6.0[/b] or higher, [b]SMAPI ver. 4.0.0[/b] or higher, [b]Content Patcher ver. 2.0.0[/b] or higher and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu ver. 1.12.0[/b] or higher.
This mod should be compatible with any other mod that doesn't change the following crafting recipes: Big Chest, Big Stone Chest, Quality Sprinkler, Iridium Sprinkler, Bomb, Mega Bomb, Glowstone Ring, Iridium Band, Quality Fertilizer, Deluxe Fertilizer, Quality Retaining Soil, Deluxe Retaining Soil, Deluxe Speed-Gro, Hyper Speed-Gro, Tree Fertilizer, Deluxe Scarecrow and Heavy Tapper.
[b][u]ATTENTION[/u] [/b]Even if you keep the vanilla version of a recipe, the mod still overwrites it, so you should still avoid using it with any other mod that touches those recipes.

[size=4][b][u]Install[/u][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list][size=4][b][u]Config Options[/u][/b][/size]

With a fresh installation of the mod nothing changes in the game, every option is disabled by default, to start recycling your goods you'll have to configure it from the mods menu, accessible by clicking the gear icon on the bottom left of the game's title screen. In the menu every option has an exhaustive tooltip when you hover your mouse on it, but let's take a look at them here too:

[size=3][b][i]Chests[/i][/b][/size]

[b]Big Chest Recipe:[/b]
[list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Wood x120, Copper Bar x2
[*][u]Recycle 1 Chest[/u]:  Chest x1, Wood x70, Copper Bar x2
[*][u]Recycle 2 Chests[/u]:  Chest x2, Wood x20, Copper Bar x2
[*][u]Recycle 3 Chests[/u]:  Chest x3, Copper Bar x1
[*][u]Recycle 4 Chests[/u]:  Chest x4
[/list][b]Big Stone Chest Recipe: 
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Stone x250
[*][u]Recycle 1 Stone Chest[/u]:  Stone Chest x1, Stone x190
[*][u]Recycle 2 Stone Chests[/u]:  Stone Chest x2, Stone x125
[*][u]Recycle 3 Stone Chests[/u]:  Stone Chest x3, Stone x60
[*][u]Recycle 4 Stone Chests[/u]:  Stone Chest x4
[/list][b][i][size=3]Sprinklers[/size][/i][/b]

[b]Quality Sprinkler Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Iron Bar x1, Gold Bar x1, Refined Quartz x1
[*][u]Recycle 1 Sprinkler[/u]:  Sprinkler x1, Gold Bar x1
[*][u]Recycle 2 Sprinklers[/u]:  Sprinkler x2, Refined Quartz x2
[*][u]Recycle 3 Sprinklers[/u]:  Sprinkler x3
[/list][b]Iridium Sprinkler Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Gold Bar x1, Iridium Bar x1, Battery Pack x1
[*][u]Recycle 1 Quality Sprinkler[/u]:  Quality Sprinkler x1, Gold Bar x1, Iridium Bar x1
[*][u]Recycle 2 Quality Sprinklers[/u]:  Quality Sprinkler x2, Battery Pack x1, Iridium Ore x1
[*][u]Recycle 3 Quality Sprinklers[/u]:  Quality Sprinkler x3, Iridium Ore x1
[/list][b][i][size=3]Bombs[/size][/i][/b]

[b]Bomb Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Iron Ore x4, Coal x1
[*][u]Recycle 1 Cherry Bomb[/u]:  Cherry Bomb x1, Iron Ore x2
[*][u]Recycle 2 Cherry Bombs[/u]:  Cherry Bomb x2
[/list][b]Mega Bomb Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Gold Ore x4, Solar Essence x1, Void Essence x1
[*][u]Recycle 1 Bomb[/u]:  Bomb x1, Gold Ore x2, Void Essence x1
[*][u]Recycle 2 Bombs[/u]:  Bomb x2
[/list][b][i][size=3]Rings[/size][/i][/b]

[b]Add Glow Ring Recipe:[/b] Check to add a recycling recipe for Glow Rings at Mining Level 2
[list]
[*][u]Glow Ring Recipe[/u]:  Small Glow Ring x2, Copper Bar x1
[/list][b]Add Magnet Ring Recipe:[/b] Check to add a recycling recipe for Magnet Rings at Mining Level 3
[list]
[*][u]Magnet Ring Recipe[/u]:  Small Magnet Ring x2, Copper Bar x1
[/list][b]Glowstone Ring Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Solar Essence x5, Iron Bar x5
[*][u]Recycle Rings[/u]:  Glow Ring x1, Magnet Ring x1, Iron Bar x1
[/list][b]Iridium Band Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Iridium Bar x5, Solar Essence x50, Void Essence x50
[*][u]Recycle Rings[/u]:  Glowstone Ring x1, Ruby Ring x1, Iridium Bar x2
[/list][b][i][size=3]Soil Additives
[/size][/i][/b]
[b]Quality Fertilizer x2 Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Sap x4, Fish (Any) x1
[*][u]Recycle 2 Basic Fertilizers[/u]:  Basic Fertilizer x2, Fish (Any) x1
[*][u]Recycle 5 Basic Fertilizers[/u]:  Basic Fertilizer x5
[/list][b]Deluxe Fertilizer x5 Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Iridium Bar x1, Sap x40
[*][u]Recycle 10 Quality Fertilizers[/u]:  Quality Fertilizer x10, Iridium Bar x1
[*][u]Recycle 25 Quality Fertilizers[/u]:  Quality Fertilizer x25
[/list][b]Quality Retaining Soil x2 Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Stone x3, Clay x1
[*][u]Recycle 2 Basic Retaining Soil[/u]:  Basic Retaining Soil x2, Clay x1
[*][u]Recycle 5 Basic Retaining Soil[/u]:  Basic Retaining Soil x5
[/list][b]Deluxe Retaining Soil Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Stone x5, Fiber x3, Clay x1
[*][u]Recycle 2 Quality Retaining Soil[/u]:  Quality Retaining Soil x2, Stone x2, Fiber x3
[*][u]Recycle 5 Quality Retaining Soil[/u]:  Quality Retaining Soil x5
[/list][b]Deluxe Speed-Gro x5 Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Oak Resin x1, Bone Fragment x5
[*][u]Recycle 5 Speed-Gro[/u]:  Speed-Gro x5, Oak Resin x1
[*][u]Recycle 10 Speed-Gro[/u]:  Speed-Gro x10
[/list][b]Hyper Speed-Gro Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Radioactive Ore x1, Bone Fragment x3, Solar Essence x1
[*][u]Recycle 3 Deluxe Speed-Gro[/u]:  Deluxe Speed-Gro x3, Radioactive Ore x1
[/list][b]Tree Fertilizer Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Fiber x5, Stone x5
[*][u]Recycle Soil Additives[/u]:  Basic Fertilizer x1, Basic Retaining Soil x1, Speed-Gro x1
[/list][b][i][size=3]More[/size][/i][/b]

[b]Deluxe Scarecrow Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Wood x50, Iridium Ore x1, Fiber x40
[*][u]Recycle 1 Scarecrow[/u]:  Scarecrow x1, Iridium Ore x1, Fiber x10
[*][u]Recycle 2 Scarecrows[/u]:  Scarecrows x2
[/list][b]Heavy Tapper Recipe:
[/b][list]
[*][u]Vanilla - no recycling[/u]:  Hardwood x30, Radioactive Bar x1
[*][u]Recycle 1 Tapper[/u]:  Tapper x1, Hardwood x15, Radioactive Bar x1
[*][u]Recycle 2 Tappers[/u]:  Tappers x2, Radioactive Bar x1
[*][u]Recycle 3 Tappers[/u]:  Tappers x3, Radioactive Ore x2
[/list][b]Add Recycled Wood Fence Recipe:[/b] Check to add a recipe for Recycled Wood Fences at Farming Level 1
[list]
[*][u]Recycled Wood Fence Recipe[/u]:  Driftwood x3
[/list][b]Add Recycled Hardwood Fence Recipe:[/b] Check to add a recipe for Recycled Hardwood Fences at Farming Level 7
[list]
[*][u]Recycled Hardwood Fence x3 Recipe[/u]:  Wood Fence x5, Hardwood x1
[/list][b]Add Heater Recipe:[/b] Check to receive a recipe for Heaters after unlocking Auto-Grabbers
[list]
[*][u]Heater Recipe[/u]:  Shears x1, Milk Pail x1
[/list][b][u][size=4]Conclusion
[/size][/u][/b]
As you can probably tell, a lot of work went into the creation of this mod. As its author, my only wish is for you to enjoy it as much as I do. Feel free to send me your feedback and suggestions and, if you like it, consider endorsing it to help others discover the joys of recycling.

Thank you, see you next mod.
SGUERO
